Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Review and What-ifs
- Mitigation used too late can now be tested in What-ifs. These abilities appear red, explain why when hovered, and include 'used late' when shared to chat.
- Added a gentle pulsing highlight to Expired Mits so it's easier to notice. Disabled when reduced motion is enabled.
- Improved tracking of defensive buffs, including buffs used before combat starts.
- Fixed expired or removed buffs sometimes appearing active.
- Review, Death Window, chat summaries, and What-ifs now use the same captured mitigation information and calculation rules.
- Fixed cases where hits from different enemies could use the wrong enemy's debuffs.
- Fixed What-if availability for abilities that share a cooldown or have multiple charges.
- Fixed some mitigation calculations, including effects being counted twice.

Replay
- Added missing defensive effects, including Sun Sign and some shields.
- Improved accuracy when showing who received an effect and when it ended.

P4 Analyzer
- Fixed real/fake tells being matched to the wrong Grand Cross round, which could give incorrect instructions.
- Fixed some wrong-side deaths being shown as correct.
- Flood results now use the recorded evidence to identify correct positioning, the wrong side, or being caught in the middle.
- Shows Not resolved when Flood never happened. If Flood happened but the recording lacks enough information about a player, it shows No result captured instead of guessing.
- Improved handling of wounds that keep the same color and players dying during Flood.

Performance
- Reduced unnecessary work while viewing death reviews and Replay.
- Fixed memory usage continuing to grow while viewing certain death timelines.
